description: This PHP class 'CustomerDao' provides data access methods for managing Customer entities within the OrangeHRM Time Plugin. It includes functions for retrieving, saving, deleting customers, and related operations such as checking for existing customer IDs, searching with filters, and handling related projects and activities.

classes.name: CustomerDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for performing database operations related to Customer entities in the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Fetches an active customer by ID if it exists; returns null otherwise.

methods.name: getExistingCustomerIds
methods.description: Retrieves the IDs of existing customers from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes customers by IDs after confirming they have no associated timesheet items; performs transaction management.

methods.name: saveCustomer
methods.description: Persists a Customer entity to the database.

methods.name: searchCustomers
methods.description: Searches customers based on filter parameters and returns a list of matching customers.

methods.name: getSearchCustomerPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for customer search with applied filters and pagination.

methods.name: getSearchCustomersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of customers matching the search filter criteria.

methods.name: isCustomerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a customer name is already in use, excluding a certain customer ID if provided.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Fetches any customer by ID, regardless of deletion status.

methods.name: getCustomerIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of customer IDs, optionally including deleted ones.

methods.name: getCustomerIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Returns customer IDs associated with a given project admin, optionally including deleted customers.

methods.name: hasCustomerGotTimesheetItems
methods.description: Checks if a customer has any associated timesheet items.

methods.name: getUnselectableCustomerIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of customers that are associated with timesheet items and thus might be unselectable for certain operations.

methods.name: deleteRelativeProjectsForCustomer
methods.description: Deletes related projects, activities, and project admins for the specified customer IDs.
